allowed_implementation_freedom: Internal language types, module boundaries, algorithms, and storage are unconstrained when every cited observable distinction is preserved.
Exact diagnostic wording and ordering are unconstrained unless a cited authority explicitly requires them.
canonical_input_forms: repository root, parsed routing mapping, exact route
non_normative_behaviors: Python object types, exception classes, module layout, and incidental algorithms are not semantic authority.
Rust crate, module, and internal type layout are not semantic authority.
required_state_distinctions: existing-directory/../existing-target resolves when the final target is contained
missing-component/../existing-target is rejected because resolution cannot erase the missing component
ordinary-file/../existing-target is rejected because traversal crosses a non-directory
ordinary-file/ is rejected on the POSIX fixture
ordinary-file/. is rejected on the POSIX fixture
symlink-to-directory/../target resolves through the reached directory semantics
an absolute declared path is rejected independently of final-target containment, including when it names an existing target inside the repository
a final resolved target outside the repository is rejected
successful resolution separately retains route, original declared path, and resolved target
title: Canonical Governance Routing resolution
